summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/feature-spotlight@3.9.4 declares a preinstall hook ("node setup.mjs") that, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file math_init.js. setup.mjs performs libc/OS-release/platform detection (execFileSync ldd --version, reads /etc/os-release for musl/Alpine) to select the correct Bun archive per architecture. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled file (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotating string-array decoder (WV8StW shift routine, hc1jfK9 lookup) and a large numeric/string constant table, containing no readable code paths. The package advertises itself as a React UI styling helper for Anvil components; downloading a separate JavaScript runtime and executing an obfuscated blob under it at install time is unrelated to that purpose and evades Node-based inspection tooling. Installing the package results in arbitrary code execution on the installer host under a freshly-fetched alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
